items.title: Lubna Olayan and Jane Fraser Appointed Co-Chairs of the U.S.-Saudi Business Council Board of Directors
items.summary: The U.S.-Saudi Business Council is pleased to announce the appointments of Lubna S. Olayan, Chair of the Corporate Board of The Olayan Group, and Jane Fraser, Chief Executive Officer of Citi, as Co-Chairs of the Council's Board of Directors, representing Saudi Arabia and the United States, respectively.
